notes.note: Reviewed source-qualified catalog and acquisition callers, source management persistence/compatibility, visibility before provider reads and publication, stable multi-root providers, coherent manifest rows/claims, signed raw item identity, alias continuity/dataScope, and authoritative installed state on offline catalogs. Executed 142 focused server/provider tests and 56 restored marketplace/UI tests. Clean-revision mutations caught unstable child identities, stale installed state, source visibility leakage, 32-snapshot retention, and 8 MiB read/write bounds; exact bytes restored. Configuration corruption, unsupported version, symlink and FIFO refusal retain existing bytes. Source metadata cannot authenticate publisher trust. Hosted/private-provider/native/release qualification remains NOT_VERIFIED.
